title: Verify the enrollment mailbox accepts only public protocol fields

evidence: Red assertions: the Workerd live and zero-plaintext tests expected HTTP 400 for a mismatched approver and plaintext device name, but received 201. Green d7f878d1f5 on harbor-mbp-2: cd packages/hub && node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/routes/sync-v1-*.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, 16/16 pass, including preserved claim/reveal/approval order and no plaintext name in account-object storage.

title: Verify native enrollment and atomic revocation for an existing sealed account

evidence: At b9723e45a2: signed-in phone browser fixture routes Devices to native and renders approval copy, connected 320px/390px dialogs pass, 17 Hub Workerd API cases pass at one worker on harbor-mbp-2. Swift sealed vectors and interop, mismatched signer/missing grant, biometric denial and revoke-to-next-epoch checks pass. Simulator product compiles.
